methods_quotes.q: Population proportions and other percentages, means, and standard errors were estimated using software that accounts for the complex survey design.
For all estimates, the sums of two 24-hour recalls per person and 2-day dietary sample weights were used.
Sample weights accounted for the probability of selection, survey nonresponse, and the proportion of weekend/weekday combinations of the two 24-hour dietary recalls.
